usedFor: Nozbe holds tasks and Google Docs holds your notes, so “New Task” can run “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task” in Nozbe, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each task you create in Nozbe is added to a document tab, which gives you a readable task log.

watchOut: “New Task” in Nozbe is polling, so the document updates after a scheduled check.
